A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain 14 complete, readable pages, including Appendices A–D. Full-text comparison and rendered-page checks support a reliable comparison of equations, figures, tables and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original regression and fairness experiments on Communities & Crimes, ACSIncome and ACSTravelTime in Section 4, with additional comparisons in Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains the original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix D, including benchmark comparisons, sensitivity analyses and approximation experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged. The Appendix A.2 correction aligns a proof equation with the existing method definition; it does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three regression datasets and retain the same single- and multiple-protected-attribute scenarios. No dataset, task or population coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: KRR-FKL, NN-HGR and DUMMY in Figure 1; SVR-INPL in Figure 3; and NN-FREM and NN-HGR-L alongside the retained comparators in Appendix D, Figure 5.

E3.justification: The evaluation protocols, MAE and fairness metrics, model configurations, hyperparameter settings and approximation levels are identical in Section 4 and Appendices B–D.

E4.justification: Both versions retain identical analyses of multiple protected attributes, ridge-regularization sensitivity, linear versus kernel removal, Nystroem approximation and larger neural-network topology.

E5.justification: Section 4.1.3 reports the same five-fold cross-validation and empirical standard deviations displayed as error bars. No run-count, seed or statistical reporting changes appear.

E6.justification: Figures 1–5 are visually identical, including plotted results and error bars. The associated numerical statements, rankings and qualitative findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix A.2 corrects the opening equality in the proof of Theorem 3.2: both G factors defining K at iteration m now have index m instead of m−1. This repairs an incorrect equality and agrees with Equation (10); the theorem and remaining derivation are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about extending null-space projections to kernels, model-agnostic applicability, out-of-sample extension and competitive empirical performance.

C2.justification: Result interpretations, applicability qualifications, computational and storage limitations, future directions and the impact statement are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, hyperparameters in Tables A.1–A.2, approximation details and the code-access link are identical. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works and positioning relative to prior projection and kernel-fairness methods are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 3 June 2026 to v3 dated 3 August 2026. Prose, terminology and section organization are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, algorithm displays and page layout are unchanged. The localized proof correction does not reorganize the equation display or surrounding material.

improvement.justification: The Appendix A.2 correction removes an incorrect iteration-index equality and makes that proof step consistent with Equation (10). This provides a limited improvement in mathematical accuracy; the method, empirical evidence, exposition and conclusions otherwise remain unchanged.
